# apple_game_center_achievement_image (Resource)

Uploads the image of a Game Center achievement for one locale. A localization has one image; uploading another replaces it. The locale needs its localization first, so refer to the localization resource's `locale`. The image goes to the version being prepared; when the current version has been reviewed, applying a changed file starts the next one, and a change fails while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the image from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<achievement_id>/<locale>`; the next apply then uploads the configured file.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_achievement_image" "en_US" {
  achievement_id = apple_game_center_achievement.first_win.id
  locale         = apple_game_center_achievement_localization.en_US.locale
  file           = "${path.module}/first-win.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `achievement_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the achievement, e.g. `apple_game_center_achievement.example.id`.
- `file` (String) Path of the image. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.
- `locale` (String) Locale of the localization the image is for, e.g. `en-US`.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the uploaded file.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the image, which changes with each version and upload.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_achievement_image.en_US
  identity = {
    achievement_id = "9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e"
    locale         = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `achievement_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the achievement, e.g. `apple_game_center_achievement.example.id`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_achievement_image.en_US 9c1e3a5b-7d2f-4b6a-8c0e-5f7a9b1c3d4e/en-US
```
